mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.project_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, u.user_name, u.nick_name, d.dept_name from project_member m left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: select member_id, project_id, user_id, role, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from project_member where project_id = #{projectId} and role = 'HOST' and del_flag = '0'

select member_id, project_id, user_id, role, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from project_member where project_id = #{projectId} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update project_member set role = #{role}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select project_id from project_member where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'
